verdict.rationale: Omarchy documents an official `omarchy` CLI on a dedicated manual page. The docs pitch it as a way to control the system when an AI agent is helping with customization or configuration, and they show concrete commands such as `omarchy reminder 7 'Tea ready'`, `omarchy windows key` and `omarchy-snapshot create`. Missing for 10: evidence of the full command surface (only a few commands are shown), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents driving the CLI.
